thesis: The speaker argues that while Greg Abel has been practically running Berkshire Hathaway for years, the transition from Warren Buffett represents a shift from a hands-off, delegation-heavy style to a more hands-on approach that actively pursues synergies between subsidiaries. Additionally, the speaker suggests that while no one will match Warren Buffett's exceptional capital allocation, Greg Abel is an exceptional capital allocator in his own right who may perform better during periods where Buffett was not aggressive enough.
